gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules print sale of surplus and insurance proceeds inside 'Local' receipts; the statement (p4) prints them under other financing sources: Sale of surplus 230,939 (General 37,997 + Road 192,942) + Insurance proceeds 32,356 (General) = 263,295 (JSON other_financing). General Fund budget schedule (p8) Local 1,372,636 = General Fund local + 37,997 + 32,356; Road budget schedule (p10) Local 464,029 = 271,087 (p4) + 192,942. Schedule 17,312,111 - statement 17,048,816 = 263,295 exactly. No fix.

Statement p4 Total transfers in 6,064,266 = General 95,873 + Road 3,947,684 + Hard Surface Road Sinking 1,910,709 + Non-Major 110,000. The non-major combining statement (pp6-7) also prints a 4,600 transfer between non-major funds (one fund (4,600) out p6, another 4,600 in p7), netted inside the p4 Non-Major column. Detail in = 6,064,266 + 4,600 = 6,068,866. No fix.

Statement p4 Total transfers out 6,064,266 = General 5,968,393 (budget schedule p9 General 3,708,393 + Inheritance Tax 2,260,000 p5) + Non-Major 95,873. Detail out = 3,708,393 + 2,260,000 + 95,873 + 4,600 (non-major to non-major, p6) = 6,068,866; gap 4,600 = the intra-non-major transfer netted in the p4 Non-Major column. No fix.
